name: ThreatFox
tagline: IOC-sharing API for malware C2, IPs, domains, and URLs
description: ThreatFox is a community platform operated by abuse.ch in collaboration with Spamhaus for sharing and querying malware-related IOCs. Its Auth-Key API supports recent-IOC retrieval, lookup by IOC ID or value, searches by file hash, tag, or malware family, and submission of confirmed, vetted IOCs. Free use is limited to authenticated not-for-profit use under fair-use query limits; commercial use may require a paid Spamhaus subscription.

auth.details: API key via Auth-Key header (or optional api-key form field); free key from auth.abuse.ch after account signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free for authenticated not-for-profit use, subject to unpublished fair-use query-volume limits. Excessive use may be restricted or require a paid Spamhaus subscription; high-value contributors may receive discretionary access beyond the limits.

rate_limits: not fully published as numeric quotas; abuse.ch enforces rate limiting (HTTP 429); check docs/status for current guidance
use_cases: fetch recent malware C2 IOCs from the last N days
look up whether a domain, IP, or URL is a known threat IOC
search ThreatFox by malware family name
submit a new C2 or phishing IOC to the community feed
export IOCs in a format for SIEM or blocklist tooling
